authority.source: config/operator_directives.json on current main plus latest explicit user instruction

audited_v7_model_source.status: superseded research source retained for V7 model reconstruction; no direct canonical-ref mutation

source_observations: v7_local_factor_core.fit_pair builds one pair-excluded orientation-invariant temporal PC1 from predeclared controls and stores target loadings plus historical residual paths.
v7_local_factor_core_base.build_pair_signal applies the residual-z floor to fit.residual_z_a/b and starts the n-step forecast from fit.residual_a[-1] / fit.residual_b[-1].
v7_local_factor_research fetches current books but passes only the two current target mids to build_pair_signal; current control mids are not supplied for current factor reconstruction.

v7_local_factor_orientation.orientation_invariant_pc1 returns the historical temporal factor scores only; the fitted object does not persist a frozen current-observation projection map for the controls.
interpretation: The freshness repair prevents very old fitted states, but freshness alone does not make the last completed-bucket residual equal to the current executable-book residual. The current V7 LF signal path can therefore admit already-reverted states, miss newly-created dislocations, or choose the opposite direction even when the statistical fit and multiplicity layer are otherwise valid.
required_successor_contract: Freeze the pair-excluded orientation-invariant PC1 basis using training data only; never refit it using the current observation.
Persist sufficient training-only control means/scales and a sign-stable PC1 projection representation so a new control vector can be scored out of sample.
Require fresh causally coherent current books for both targets and every predeclared control; missing or stale required state fails closed.
Standardize current target/control logits with training-only moments, project the current controls onto the frozen factor basis and reconstruct current residuals for both pair legs.
Apply post-multiplicity |z| admission to these current residuals; keep historical endpoint z only as diagnostic telemetry.
Use these reconstructed current residuals in the actual-horizon n-step forecast and retain fidelity plus TTR-minus-buffer guards.

Only after current-state validity attach executable depth, authoritative fees, slippage, empirical both/A-only/B-only/none joint states, partial abort/unwind loss and audited fill-conditioned PnL with cost stress.
non_claims: This is not evidence of profitable LF alpha.
This does not justify relaxing warmup, z, FDR or economic gates.
No claim is made that any historical V7 LF candidate would have filled or made money after this repair.
